tasks.answer: Use DeleteDiscussion, the destructive confirmation control for deleting a discussion; it requires the discussion id.

The login form uses Input. It binds to react-hook-form through its required registration prop (the register('email')/register('password') result, e.g. registration={register('email')}); it must be rendered inside Form, and FieldWrapper supplies label/error.

The discussions table uses TablePagination (rendered by Table when a pagination prop is supplied). It requires totalPages, currentPage and rootUrl; hrefs are built as rootUrl?page=N, so rootUrl must not already contain a query string.
Use MDPreview, which renders Markdown as sanitized HTML with prose typography. It takes the Markdown input via the required value prop.
Use CreateDiscussion, an admin-only drawer form that creates a discussion with a title and Markdown body; it therefore requires admin permission. It has no required props.
